chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang Grinds a Bandit’s Fingers Off and Learns the Four Beams and Eight Pillars
chapter_meta_description: Troupe Master Lü’s pipe is found—Li Huowang goes full hunter. He tortures a bandit for location, learns the outlaw code of Four Beams and Eight Pillars, and marches into the stronghold for a showdown. Pure, mortal-level action.
og_title: Li Huowang Goes Full Bandit Hunter in This Brutal Rescue Arc
og_description: He breaks fingers, parses underworld code, and learns that some threats are just men with big mauls. The Dao-Twisted World’s mortal underbelly is laid bare.
twitter_title: Li Huowang’s First Mortal Fight—and It’s Brutal
twitter_description: No cosmic horror here—just a man with a sword and a grudge, dismantling a bandit stronghold piece by piece. Troupe Master Lü is counting on him.
